title: Calculator Input Form
user_story: As a calculator user, I want to enter two numbers and select an operation on a single page, so that I can prepare my calculation request.
acceptance_criteria: The root route (/) displays a plain HTML page containing exactly two number input fields.
A selection control allows picking one of the four basic operations: add, subtract, multiply, or divide.
A Calculate button submits the form data to the server.

title: Server-Side Calculation & Result Display
user_story: As a calculator user, I want the app to compute my selected operation and show the answer on the same page, so that I can immediately see the outcome.
acceptance_criteria: Submitting the form triggers server-side computation and re-renders the page with the result displayed in a labeled area.
The computed value correctly reflects the selected operation applied to the two entered numbers.
The original input values remain visible after submission for easy verification or adjustment.

title: Input Validation & Error Handling
user_story: As a calculator user, I want clear feedback when my input is invalid or causes an error, so that I can correct it without starting over.
acceptance_criteria: Entering non-numeric characters or leaving fields blank displays a clear error message in the browser.
Selecting divide with zero as the second number shows a specific warning instead of an application crash.
Error states preserve user input so corrections can be made without re-typing everything.
